__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the InfluxDB data source that reads the solark bucket.

title: Sol-Ark Modbus – Electrical Trends

targets.query:
import "strings"

base = from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart,stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_grid_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_grid_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_pv_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_pv_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_load_total_power" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_load_total_power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod,fn:last,createEmpty:false)
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with entity_id:if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_grid_total_power") then "Grid Power" else if strings.hasSuffix(v:r.entity_id,suffix:"_pv_total_power") then "Solar PV" else "Load Power",_value:float(v:r._value)}))
  |> group(columns:["_time","entity_id"])
  |> sum(column:"_value")
  |> group(columns:["entity_id"])
  |> sort(columns:["_time"])

from(bucket:"${bucket}")
|> range(start:v.timeRangeStart,stop:v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
|> filter(fn:(r)=>(r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_load_l1_current" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_load_l2_current"))
|> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod,fn:last,createEmpty:false)
|> map(fn:(r)=>({r with phase:if r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}1_load_l1_current" then "l1" else "l2"}))
|> keep(columns:["_time","_value","phase"])
|> pivot(rowKey:["_time"],columnKey:["phase"],valueColumn:"_value")
|> filter(fn:(r)=>exists r.l1 and exists r.l2)
|> map(fn:(r)=>({_time:r._time,_value:float(v:r.l1)+float(v:r.l2),entity_id:"${entity_prefix}1_load_total_current",_field:"value"}))

from(bucket:"${bucket}")
|> range(start:v.timeRangeStart,stop:v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
|> filter(fn:(r)=>(r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_load_l1_current" or r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_load_l2_current"))
|> aggregateWindow(every:v.windowPeriod,fn:last,createEmpty:false)
|> map(fn:(r)=>({r with phase:if r.entity_id=="${entity_prefix}2_load_l1_current" then "l1" else "l2"}))
|> keep(columns:["_time","_value","phase"])
|> pivot(rowKey:["_time"],columnKey:["phase"],valueColumn:"_value")
|> filter(fn:(r)=>exists r.l1 and exists r.l2)
|> map(fn:(r)=>({_time:r._time,_value:float(v:r.l1)+float(v:r.l2),entity_id:"${entity_prefix}2_load_total_current",_field:"value"}))

description: Electrical trends with combined L1–L2 and total-power/current readings; individual 120 V leg traces are omitted.
